speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. speaker: Doctor
text: The high fever of 102°F combined with decreased bowel sounds and suprapubic tenderness is highly concerning for postpartum endometritis or a bowel obstruction. Has the abdominal pain worsened in the last few hours, and is there any history of adhesions from previous surgeries? I am going to request a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis to evaluate for abscess or obstruction.
